slides.title: Starter Activity: Knowledge Retrieval

interactiveCells.question: Q1. Name the gas produced by the complete combustion of fossil fuels.
Q2. Which biological process in plants removes CO2 from the atmosphere?
Q3. Approximately what percentage of the modern Earth's atmosphere is carbon dioxide?
Q4. State one non-renewable fossil fuel commonly used to generate electricity.
Q5. What is the chemical formula for methane gas?
Q6. What happens to the temperature of a gas if it absorbs thermal energy?
